# Andreas Rudolph

> Andreas Rudolph is a Danish super-intelligence orchestrator, product engineer, sales engineer, digital artist and entrepreneur — and a father — based in Copenhagen. He is Principal Product Engineer for Web & Android at Endavu (https://endavu.com), Denmark's new investment platform.

This is the personal website of Andreas Rudolph. The front page (https://andreas-rudolph.me/) introduces him and links to five pages: Bio, Products, Projects, Art and Life.

Key facts:

- Building software since 2010, when his first Android app was published on Google Play.
- Studied computer science; started as an Android developer, then moved into technical leadership, strategy and product leadership.
- Has contributed to or led more than 20 app projects; over 1,000,000 downloads on his own apps.
- Volunteers with Coding Pirates, teaching young people to code.
- Career before Endavu: Nuuday (Senior Product & Technology Leader, Entertainment; Android Chapter Lead), YouSee/TDC (IT consultant and Android developer), Jawper (co-founder), Mobile Identity (Android project manager), CirCal (IT architect, mobile development and design).
- Apps built or led include YouSee Play, YouSee Musik & Telmore Musik, Life (digital health platform), Børn & Helbred, Digital Culture Guide, LinkAlarm, InkBlot, Bink and Awoken.
- Languages he works in include Kotlin, Rust and Python.
- Contact: onemanmobile@gmail.com · LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/andreasrudolph · X: https://x.com/OneManMobile (@OneManMobile)

## Products

- [Endavu](https://endavu.com): Denmark's new investment platform; 30,000+ stocks and ETFs at low prices, automatic tax reporting and a social investing community. Andreas is its Principal Product Engineer for Web & Android.
- [Awoken – Lucid Dreaming Tool](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.lucid_dreaming.awoken): Android dream journal and lucid dreaming trainer, on Google Play since 2013; 1,000,000+ installs, rated 4.4 by 21,000+ users.
- [Futuruna](https://futuruna.com/): A programming language for law (2026). Laws, contracts and policies become code you can run, test and audit, mixed with ordinary programs and compiled through Rust. See also [Why Futuruna](https://futuruna.com/why) and the [AI setup guide](https://futuruna.com/ai-setup.md).

## Projects

- [Sylvester Chatwell](https://github.com/OneManMobile/sylvester-chatwell): A household butler for Denmark that runs inside Grok Bot; plans weekly dinners around nemlig.com offers and fills the basket (2026).
- [Antropi](https://github.com/OneManMobile/Antropi): AI exploration based on causal entropy — intelligence as maximising future freedom of action (2024).
- [ALASCA](https://github.com/OneManMobile/ALASCA): The Android Layout Scaler (2012).
- [Android AR Kit](https://github.com/OneManMobile/Android-AR-Kit): Open-source geographic augmented reality library for Android (2012).

## Art

- [Runion Neo](https://github.com/OneManMobile/runion-neo): Display typeface; Latin and the Unicode Runic block drawn as straight lines between dots on a 3 × 7 grid. Variable weight 300–700, SIL Open Font License (2026).
- [Runion Simplex](https://github.com/OneManMobile/runion-simplex): Terminal companion to Runion Neo, same strokes on a wider lattice (2026).
- [Runion Basic](https://github.com/OneManMobile/Runion-Font): The first experiment; the Elder Futhark on the same dot grid (2026).
- [Coding Pirates badges](https://github.com/OneManMobile/CodingPiratesAchievements): Achievement badge illustrations for Coding Pirates, the Danish coding club for kids (2016).
